cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the signal to cut the ribbon. First, introduce the engineer who kept this bridge out of the river.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This is the town's day. I don't want a speech about one person.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. One sentence will do, and then straight to the town. I'll keep the ceremony moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already thanked the engineering team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then just add 'especially' and my name. That can finish the thanks you've given. Give me that much, and I'll signal the ribbon straight away.
